name: Frenchmen
description: The Frenchmen were a street gang based in Brownsville, Brooklyn, active during the 1950s and 1960s. They were one of at least 11 fighting gangs operating in Brownsville, a neighborhood documented in a 1960 World Telegram and Sun report as home to 62 active fighting gangs across Brooklyn. The Frenchmen were bitter rivals of the Roman Lords, a Puerto Rican gang from the same neighborhood. In 1962, 18 members of the Frenchmen shot and killed a Roman Lord and seriously injured another.

sources.title: Memoir Excerpt from Efraim Ruiz of the Roman Lords | New York City Fighting Gangs
